text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, we give a computer training data that includes correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that the computer learns. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can predict if an email is spam or not. We check the model's accuracy by comparing its predictions with the real answers. The more training data we use, the better the model often becomes.
